free_tier.stated: Free plan, USD 0 a month: 50,000 requests a month, up to 5,000 a day and at most 2,000 a minute, one IP lookup per request, no credit card
free_tier.notes: Basic is USD 4.50 a month for 100,000 lookups, Starter USD 32 for 1,000,000 and Business USD 120 for 5,000,000; usage notices at 80% and 100%.

egress.terms: not applicable: JSON answers, not metered in bytes

interface_detail: GET https://api.sthan.io/IpGeolocation/{ip} with an Authorization: Bearer key answers JSON; an omitted IP geolocates the caller; every answer carries X-RateLimit-ByEndpoint-Per{Minute|Hour|Day|Month} headers and the remaining counts
tooling: any HTTP client; a 429 answer carries Retry-After and an Errors list naming the limit reached
chaining: 50,000 lookups a month with city, postal code, timezone, ASN, ISP and proxy and hosting flags from one email sign-up. Bulk path: none; single IP lookup per request.

limits.value: 50,000 requests a month and 5,000 a day on the Free plan
2,000 requests a minute on the Free plan; HTTP 429 with Retry-After past a limit

binding_note: the daily count of 5,000 requests is met before the monthly 50,000 or the 2,000 a minute rate.

identity_cost.detail: an email address, verified before the key works, or GitHub or Google sign-in; no credit card

reliability_note: at a limit the API answers HTTP 429 Too Many Requests with Retry-After and an Errors list; a keyless call answered HTTP 401
confidence_note: The pricing, product, documentation and sign-up pages were quoted on 2026-11-02 and a keyless call answered HTTP 401; no keyed lookup was made, so the limits are the vendor's.
